steps.what: Inventory medical, laboratory and office supplies and record usable stock and pending orders
outputs: dated stock count with usable quantities and pending orders

steps.what: Compare inventory with approved stock levels and prepare supply orders
inputs: dated stock count with usable quantities and pending orders
outputs: draft supply order with quantity calculations

steps.what: Check supply orders, resolve shortages and release authorised purchases
inputs: draft supply order with quantity calculations

tasks.design: Configure reorder arithmetic in {PROCUREMENT} from counted usable stock, outstanding orders and approved stock parameters. The assistant retains physical counting, demand judgement and purchase release; unusual equipment requests go through the existing authority process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counts are manually compared with stock levels and pack sizes, while expiry and clinical suitability still require people.
tasks.enabler_now: Native procurement rules can calculate a draft quantity without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise unusable stock, changing service needs and unacceptable substitutions.
tasks.human_edge: Prevent a superficially correct reorder from creating a clinical shortage.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repetitive order arithmetic while retaining stock awareness.

reach.task: Agree stock levels and purchase limits
reach.learn: Which items require special shortage escalation

evidence.claim: Native reorder arithmetic is a proposed deterministic configuration; no measured medical assistant case is supplied.

assumptions: The assistant produces item identifiers, usable quantities, count dates and pending-order references in s1; all capture time remains in its 50 percent share.
The practice manager produces approved minimum and target stock, pack sizes, suppliers and purchase limits during rollout; recurring maintenance is counted below.
Supplier catalogue availability and price are checked during retained review; no free live availability feed is assumed.
Use native configuration first. Missing parameters or incompatible units require manual ordering with no saving.
Only purchases within delegated authority are released by the assistant; other approvals retain the existing process.
unknowns: Current stock parameters and counting method
research_questions: Does draft reorder calculation save time after count entry and pack-size corrections?

already_counted.description: Physical inventory and purchase review remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Assistant reports stale stock and catalogue parameters.
Practice manager maintains stock targets and approval limits.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final supply order item, quantity, pack, supplier, price and delivery terms; edits or new count information void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=50+12.5+25=87.5; gross 12.5 less 1 focal upkeep gives net 11.5. Low covers unusable parameters or capture overhead; no physical count saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule tests or admission with medical facilities

steps.what: Verify the referral and capture patient scheduling constraints and contact permissions
Contact medical facilities to find suitable test or admission appointments
Confirm the appointment with the facility and patient and record scheduling details

tasks.design: Use a facility's existing booking portal {PARTNER_PORTAL} to find suitable slots, keeping the request and confirmation in the clinical scheduling record {OTHER}. The assistant verifies the referral and patient constraints and confirms the exact appointment; telephone coordination remains for unsupported facilities and admission exceptions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calls are needed to discover availability where direct booking access is absent.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing facility portals may expose suitable slots without a new model or scheduling agent.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish clinically appropriate booking categories and accommodate patient needs.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an appointment option does not satisfy the referral and ask the facility or clinician.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time discovering availability and retain coordination responsibility.

reach.task: Resolve referral and appointment category mismatches
reach.learn: Which request fields prevent repeat calls

evidence.claim: Portal-based booking is a proposed deterministic alternative; availability for external admission scheduling is site dependent.

assumptions: The clinician produces the authorised referral in existing care; the assistant captures and verifies patient identifiers, referral category, availability, access needs and permission in s1.
Facility scheduling staff produce and maintain portal slot inventory as part of existing scheduling; no newly cleaned slot feed is assumed.
Patient agreement is obtained within retained s3 time; patient and facility work is unchanged and earns no focal saving.
Portal options must match the referral; no automatic clinical urgency or eligibility inference is permitted.
Use existing portal access first; absent slots, unsupported admissions or stale information fall back to calls without saving.
research_questions: How much availability-search time is removed for supported facilities after portal entry?

already_counted.description: Referral capture and final coordination remain fully counted.
Portal search and category checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Assistant checks portal access changes and reports booking discrepancies.
Practice administrator maintains booking permissions and facility instructions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, referral, facility, appointment category, date, time and requirements shown at booking; any change requires renewed confirmation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+17.5+35=82.5; gross 17.5 less 1 focal upkeep gives net 16.5. High requires usable existing slot access; low is telephone-only or complex admission coordination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep financial records and manage patient statements

steps.what: Reconcile patient charges, receipts and credits and capture unresolved account discrepancies
outputs: reconciled account entries and discrepancy list

steps.what: Update financial records and prepare monthly patient statements from reconciled entries
inputs: reconciled account entries and discrepancy list
outputs: draft financial records and monthly statement batch

steps.what: Verify financial records, send monthly statements and handle credit or collection exceptions
inputs: draft financial records and monthly statement batch
reconciled account entries and discrepancy list
outputs: released statements and checked financial records

tasks.design: Configure the existing finance package {ERP} to reuse reconciled account entries and prepare a fixed monthly statement batch. The assistant keeps source reconciliation, final release, credit conversations and collection exceptions; no model calculates debt or chooses collection action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Re-entering balances and assembling statements repeats arithmetic and document work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native ledger rules and statement templates can reuse verified entries deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Identify misapplied payments and resolve disputed debts or credit decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Handle patient concerns and escalate contested balances.
tasks.altitude: Reduce routine statement preparation while retaining account reconciliation.

reach.learn: Which source mismatches cause incorrect patient balances

evidence.claim: Billing arithmetic and standard messages can use deterministic rules; this is an E1 workflow proposal without measured savings evidence.

assumptions: Billing staff produce authorised charges and credit decisions; payment staff produce receipts during existing transactions. Those unchanged source processes are outside this bookkeeping task.
The assistant produces reconciled patient account, charge, payment, credit, balance and contact fields in s1; all capture and missing-data resolution time remains.
The finance owner supplies the approved statement template during rollout and maintains it as counted below.
Use native finance configuration first; missing source identity or disputed balances block batch inclusion and retain manual handling.
Savings require a genuine manual preparation baseline; if statements already run natively, savings are zero.
unknowns: Existing statement automation and source quality
research_questions: How much statement assembly is truly manual after source reconciliation and final review?

already_counted.description: Reconciliation, final review and collection exceptions remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Assistant monitors batch failures and tests changed statement fields.
Finance administrator maintains templates and account mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected financial entries and statement batch including patient, recipient, charges, payments, credits and balance; any record or recipient change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+10+30=70; gross 30 less 2 focal upkeep gives net 28. Low covers already automated statements or source exceptions; no credit or collection conversation saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use existing systems for reorder arithmetic, slot discovery and statement preparation while retaining verification and external commitments.
reach: Maintain clear stock requirements with the practice manager
Resolve appointment categories with facility schedulers
Resolve account exceptions with finance staff
role.ambitious_version: An assistant who coordinates reliable supplies, appointments and accounts with less repetitive preparation.
